scope: prototype geometry, lighting, bounded texture prefetch, simulator validation
limitations: Simulator debug data is not physical device performance or end-to-end display latency.
The curl is an anchored row approximation, not a physical paper solver or Apple Books parity claim.
Sources are typography/PNG fixtures and a simple generated PDF; production EPUB/CBZ preparation is not covered.
RGBA accounting excludes decoder and GPU driver overhead; short RSS samples do not establish absence of leaks.

android_input.excludes: touch hardware sampling, compositor presentation, display scanout
